name: B10-0227/2026 (ECR) – Ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on ensuring accountability and justice in response to Russia’s continued attacks against the civilian population in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop its war against Ukraine, pull out its troops and pay for the damage. It asks the European Union to keep supporting Ukraine, including with air defence. It wants those responsible for war crimes punished, including through a special court, and Ukrainian children taken to Russia returned. It also asks for more sanctions and for frozen Russian money to be used to compensate Ukraine. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament is stating demands, not passing law.
- **Who it affects:** Russia, Ukraine, European Union governments and frozen Russian assets.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission and member states for follow-up.
